gloss: to be out of breath; to pant

definitions.gloss: to be out of breath; to pant; to gasp for air
definitions.explanation: To become breathless from physical exertion such as running, climbing, or heavy exercise. Often used in the て-form ({息|いき}を{切|き}らして) to describe someone's state while doing something.

examples.japanese: {息|いき}を{切|き}らして⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}って→上る：21460_noboru⟧{息|いき}を{切|き}らして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was out of breath from climbing the stairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{息|いき}を{切|き}らし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He started making excuses for being late while gasping for breath.

notes:
Literally "to cut off one's breath." The most common form is {息|いき}を{切|き}らして (te-form), used to describe someone who is panting or breathless while doing something else.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {息|いき}を{切|き}らして + verb: doing something while out of breath
- {息|いき}を{切|き}らし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: while panting
- {息|いき}を{切|き}らした⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: looking out of breath

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{息切|いきぎ}れ→息切れ：06300_ikigire⟧: shortness of breath — the noun form; can also refer to a medical symptom
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to be out of breath — similar meaning, slightly more literary
- ゼーゼー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wheeze — onomatopoeic, emphasizes the sound of labored breathing
- はあはあ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pant — onomatopoeic, lighter than ゼーゼー
